name: Italo Moletto Lobos
subtitle: PhD in Remote Sensing | Earth System Data Engineer | GeoAI | HPC & Cloud Expert
summary: PhD in Remote Sensing and co-founder of AgroSpace. I turn multi-sensor Earth observation into operational products for food and water security, from yield forecasting for NASA Harvest and global crop calendars for ESA WorldCereal to petabyte-scale HPC and cloud pipelines.
